{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
raw_data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for loyal customers only
loyal_data = raw_data[raw_data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Check the size
print("Number of loyal customer orders:", len(loyal_data))

# Check if any loyal orders are refunded
print("Refunded orders among loyal customers:", (loyal_data['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Check if any loyal orders have revenue 999999.99
print("QA orders among loyal customers (revenue == 999999.99):", (loyal_data['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Check the converted counts in loyal group
converted_counts = loyal_data['converted'].value_counts()
print("Converted status among loyal:")
print(converted_counts)

# Compute the fraction
fraction_converted = converted_counts.get(1, 0) / len(loyal_data)
print(f"\nFraction of loyal customers who converted: {fraction_converted}")

# Confirm the result
print(f"\nFinal fraction: {fraction_converted:.4f}")"}
